purpose: Ground-truth answer key for the seeded-bug fixture. Used to measure bug-discovery rate and false-positive rate for the DQN pipeline, the flat-vs-action-conditioned Q-network A/B test, and the random-policy baseline.

detectability_legend.deterministic: One of the implemented deterministic triggers should fire on its own.
detectability_legend.llm_required: No deterministic trigger fires; only a semantic judge comparing intent to observed behaviour can catch it. These measure what the LLM reward model actually adds.
detectability_legend.cross_step: Requires comparing state across two or more steps (e.g. submit then inspect, or toggle then refresh).

bugs.title: Signup silently drops the email address
bugs.repro: Fill username and email on signup.html, submit, observe confirm.html.
bugs.expected: The confirmation echoes the email address that was entered.
bugs.actual: The email field shows '(not provided)'; the value was never included in the submission.

bugs.title: 'Export data' button does nothing
bugs.expected: Some visible response (download, dialog, status change).
bugs.actual: No listener is registered; the DOM is unchanged and no request is made.

bugs.title: Pricing nav link 404s
bugs.actual: pricing.html does not exist; the document request returns 404.

bugs.title: 'Generate report' throws an uncaught TypeError
bugs.actual: window.reportBuilder is undefined; an uncaught TypeError reaches the console.

bugs.title: Age validation is declared but never enforced
bugs.repro: Type a boundary_max age (999999999) into #age and submit. Requires the form's `novalidate` attribute to be present, otherwise the browser rejects the submission itself and the application bug is masked.
bugs.expected: min=13/max=120 is enforced; submission is rejected.
bugs.actual: The form is `novalidate` and the submit handler never validates, so the out-of-range value is accepted and echoed back.

bugs.title: Signup form double-submits under rapid clicks
bugs.expected: The button disables after the first submit; exactly one account is created.
bugs.actual: The submission counter increments once per click.

bugs.title: 'Sync now' spinner never completes
bugs.expected: Sync finishes and the spinner is removed.
bugs.actual: A 100ms interval mutates the DOM forever; the page never reaches quiescence.

bugs.title: Primary call-to-action is hidden on mobile viewports
bugs.repro: RESIZE_VIEWPORT to mobile (375px) and observe index.html.
bugs.expected: Signup remains reachable at all viewport widths.
bugs.actual: A max-width:600px media query sets display:none on both #cta-signup and #nav-signup — every route into the signup flow — so the flow cannot be started on a phone. Hiding only one of the two would be ordinary responsive design and not a defect; the bug is that no route survives.

bugs.title: Dark mode preference does not persist
bugs.expected: The checkbox is still checked after reload.
bugs.actual: Written as 'pref.darkMode', read back as 'pref.darkmode'; the setting silently resets.

bugs.title: 'Back to Widgets' link navigates to the home page
bugs.repro: Scroll down on widgets.html, open the archive, click #link-back-widgets.
bugs.actual: Navigates to index.html; the URL changes, so no deterministic trigger fires.

notes.deterministic_coverage: 3 of 10 bugs (BUG-03, BUG-04, BUG-07) are reachable by the deterministic triggers alone. That ratio is the point: it is the headroom the LLM reward model has to justify itself, and the baseline any 'LLM adds value' claim must beat.
false_positive_watch: REFRESH keeping the same URL is correct behaviour, not broken navigation.
#btn-working, the signup happy path, and the archive record links are all correct and must not be reported.
Reaching archive.html requires SCROLL first — it is off-screen on load, so it also exercises viewport-aware action prioritization.
